preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each of n_0, n_1, and n_2 must be between 0 and 100.
At least one of n_0, n_1, or n_2 must be greater than 0.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines must equal the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all('0' in s and '1' in s for s in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output string must contain at least one '0' and one '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n_0 + n_1 + n_2 + 1 for s in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output string must have a length equal to the sum of n_0, n_1, n_2 plus one.
